deployment_and_prestate_reconciliation.stable_time_domain_explanation: Genesis timestamp is set to 1700000000 matching rho (1700000000), ensuring drip() rate accrual does not advance during call execution.

contract_architecture.proxy: OpenZeppelin ERC1967Proxy deployed with ctor (impl, initialize()) where initialize selector is 0x8129fc1c with no arguments
contract_architecture.execution_target: All vault operations call the ERC1967 proxy address directly, which delegatecalls to SUsds implementation, preserving proxy address as address(this).

Functional operations: deposit, mint, withdraw, redeem under D0/D1 premises
Typed kernel adapters: deposit and redeem templates, registry, evaluated transitions, soundness
Quote-register Typed wrap of delivered token0 library without editing P16 statements
Concrete runtime test fixtures and examples

Axiom audit over DefiKernel.Vault and Token0Bridge

new_assumptions.statement: UsdsMock, VatMock, and UsdsJoinMock stand in for Maker/Sky external infrastructure; ERC20 transfers mutate balances without external reentrancy hooks or fees.
SUsds contract is deployed behind OpenZeppelin ERC1967Proxy and initialized with initialize() selector 0x8129fc1c, setting chi=RAY and rho=block.timestamp.
Fixtures execute under stable-time domain D0 (timestamp=1700000000, chi=RAY) and D1 (timestamp=1700000000, chi=RAY+1 storage seed); drip() rate accrual does not advance during call.
Successful external call alone does not prove asset movement; post-state balances of all 19 cells are explicitly evaluated and verified.
Actor addresses are deterministically assigned synthetic addresses (S=0x1111...0001 through VOW=0x1111...0005) funded in genesis, not live mainnet addresses.

interface_changes.description: Expanded from 4 pure arithmetic inputs in P16 to 19 state cells covering assets, shares, supplies, and allowances across two tokens.
Fork upgraded from Istanbul to Shanghai (shanghaiTime=0), supporting Solidity 0.8.21 with PUSH0 opcode.
Typed kernel template extended to manage two asset classes (underlying asset USDS and vault share sUSDS) simultaneously.
Token0 pure helper bridged into Typed framework via synthetic QuoteSqrtP register with proven nonzero effect (postQ - preQ != 0).
Log parser tracks call-frame stack across CALL and DELEGATECALL, binding emitted events to true executing addresses rather than heuristic transfer field inspection.
